_comment: Stub Recommend.us vendor data (SPEC 7.5, open question #2 - real schema pending). Shaped to exercise every branch of the bizcheck chain: good fit, low fit, community conflict, geography miss, forwarding block, and no vendor at all.

category_fit_adjustments._comment: Optional per-story refinements applied on top of base_service_fit by StubVendorRepository.service_fit(). Keyed by intent_type.

forwarding_rules._comment: Internal forwarding rules (SPEC 7.5 check 5). blocked_categories applies globally; blocked_vendor_geographies blocks specific vendor/geography pairs.
